DeviceRegistration.title: DeviceRegistration
DeviceRegistration.description: A divi TV or Phone device registered under the user's cloud remote panel.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

deviceMac.description: Virtual MAC address displayed on the device (e.g. D4:A1:B2:C3:E4:F5).

deviceKey.description: 6-digit pairing key displayed on the device.

platform.description: Whether the device is an Android TV or Phone/Tablet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the device was first registered (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last check-in (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

RemotePlaylist.title: RemotePlaylist
RemotePlaylist.description: An IPTV M3U or Xtream Codes subscription pushed remotely from the web control panel or another device.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

targetMac.description: Target device MAC address or 'ALL' for every device on the account.

name.description: Display name for the IPTV playlist.

serverUrl.description: Optional Xtream Codes server host URL.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: User's registered Android TV and Phone divi devices.

/users/{userId}/remote_playlists/{playli.description: Remote IPTV M3U and Xtream subscriptions pushed from the web control panel.
